steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thuy Chien, a water element living water droplet warrior, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: eyeing the food; (3) EAT: absorbing it into its watery body; (4) EAT: the food visibly swirling inside it. Row 2: (5) EAT: its body sparkling, satisfied; (6) PLAY: squishing down; (7) PLAY: splashing upward; (8) PLAY: turning into a curling wave mid-air. Row 3: (9) PLAY: surfing on a small wave; (10) PLAY: splash landing into a puddle shape; (11) PLAY: reforming and cheering; (12) REFUSE food: rippling and turning away. Row 4: (13) PETTED: wobbling happily, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a water fist; (15) SAD: melting into a sad puddle shape; (16) ANGRY: boiling with bubbles.
